annotations.title: Build a full Meta ad (campaign -> ad set -> ad, paused)

description: Build a complete, ready-to-run Meta ad: campaign -> ad set (FULL targeting + budget + schedule + bidding) -> creative -> ad(s), ALL created PAUSED — it spends NOTHING until you activate the campaign with set_meta_campaign_status(confirm:true). This is the "create a campaign and put the ads on it" path. IMAGE, VIDEO (uploaded, transcoded and thumbnailed for you) and CAROUSEL (format:"carousel", 2–10 cards each with its own headline/description/link) all work. Targeting is the `targeting` object: geo down to cities with a radius, age, gender, interests, behaviours, custom audiences and lookalikes, languages, placements, devices and OS. For a conversion objective pass pixelId + conversionEvent and the ad set optimizes for that conversion. Schedule with startTime/endTime + dayparting; bid with bidStrategy + bidAmountUsd/minRoas; use lifetimeBudgetUsd (with endTime) for a fixed flight. Attach to an existing campaign with campaignId or an existing ad set with adSetId. Everything is READ BACK from Meta before you are told it exists — print the returned summary verbatim (it carries 24-hour Meta PREVIEW LINKS for the first ad — hand them to the user; preview_meta_ad renders any ad in any placement). Needs ads-management on the connected account. BOOST AN EXISTING POST: pass boostPostId — a post you have ALREADY published (numeric id, the <pageId>_<postId> form, or a permalink) — INSTEAD of any creative, and the ad promotes that post exactly as published, comments and all. The post keeps its own caption and media, so message/headline/description do NOT apply. AN INSTAGRAM BOOST TAKES A BUTTON: pass cta (e.g. SHOP_NOW, SIGN_UP) and link and the boosted post carries that button to that link; a FACEBOOK post boost takes no button and keeps the post as published. Anything not applied is named in the reply, and the reply reads back from Meta which post the ad promotes. Targeting, budget, schedule, bidding and PAUSED-by-default all work identically. AN INSTAGRAM POST NEEDS boostTarget:"instagram" — IG media ids and Facebook post ids are both bare digits, so Hermoso never guesses, and a Facebook boost given an IG media id is refused. Instagram eligibility is checked for free before anything is created (Meta refuses to boost a post carrying licensed music or an interactive element).

adSetId.description: attach the ad(s) to an EXISTING ad set (skips ad-set creation)

days.description: weekdays the window runs on: 0 = Sunday through 6 = Saturday

endMinute.description: end of the daypart window, minutes from midnight (0 to 1440)

startMinute.description: start of the daypart window, minutes from midnight (0 to 1440)

bidAmountUsd.description: REQUIRED for a bid cap / cost cap

bidStrategy.description: bidding: lowest cost, bid cap, cost cap or minimum ROAS (Meta's strategy names)

boostPostId.description: Promote a post that ALREADY EXISTS instead of building a new ad from media. Accepts the numeric post id, <pageId>_<postId>, or a permalink (an Instagram post is its NUMERIC media id — an instagram.com link carries only a shortcode, which Meta cannot resolve). Cannot be combined with image/video inputs. The post keeps its caption and media; an INSTAGRAM boost also takes cta + link (a button on the boosted post), a Facebook one takes neither.

boostTarget.description: Which surface the boosted post lives on. Default facebook. REQUIRED for an Instagram post: an IG media id and a Facebook post id are both bare digits, so this is never inferred — Meta takes a different creative for each (object_story_id for a Page post; object_id + instagram_user_id + source_instagram_media_id for an IG post).

brandedContentSponsorIgId.description: PARTNERSHIP AD — the Instagram account id shown as the PAID PARTNER on this ad (Meta’s `instagram_branded_content.sponsor_id`), so the ad runs as a creator collaboration rather than as a plain brand ad. Hermoso sends this id EXACTLY as given and does not work out which id belongs in which slot — Meta’s own two published examples disagree on that — so confirm the ad’s identity in Ads Manager before it is switched on.

brandedContentSponsorPageId.description: PARTNERSHIP AD — the Facebook Page id of the paid partner (Meta’s `facebook_branded_content.sponsor_page_id`). Give BOTH halves when the ad runs across both surfaces: supplying only one leaves the other surface’s placements with no partnership label at all, and the returned summary says which half is missing rather than letting it be discovered in Ads Manager.

campaignId.description: attach to an existing campaign instead of creating one

cards.description: carousel cards in order — each may set its own headline/description/link

description.description: description line for this carousel card

link.description: destination URL for this carousel card

carouselEndCard.description: append the Page end card to a carousel

country.description: 2-letter shorthand when you are not passing full targeting (default US)

creativeEnhancements.description: META'S AUTOMATIC CREATIVE ENHANCEMENTS (Advantage+ creative: AI text overlays, stickers, templates, generated backgrounds, uncropping, text rewrites, translation…). DEFAULT "off": every one is explicitly switched OFF so the ad runs exactly as made. "meta" leaves Meta's own defaults. Or an object turning named ones on, e.g. {"image_touchups": true} (everything else stays off). Names: adapt_to_placement, add_text_overlay, creative_stickers, description_automation, enhance_cta, image_animation, image_background_gen, image_brightness_and_contrast, image_templates, image_text_translation, image_touchups, image_uncrop, inline_comment, media_type_automation, pac_relaxation, product_extensions, reveal_details_over_time, text_optimizations, text_translation, translate_voiceover, video_auto_crop, video_filtering, video_uncrop. The reply reads back what Meta stored.

cta.description: call-to-action, e.g. SHOP_NOW / LEARN_MORE / SIGN_UP (default LEARN_MORE); WHATSAPP_MESSAGE for a click-to-WhatsApp ad (see destinationType). Any Meta call-to-action type works (SEE_DETAILS…); unknown ones are refused, not swapped.

customConversionId.description: Meta custom conversion id (digits), from Meta Events Manager

dailyBudgetUsd.description: ad-set daily budget in the AD ACCOUNT's currency (historical name — not necessarily USD; default 10, or 1,000 in a whole-unit currency like JPY) — spends only once ACTIVE. Under a campaign that HAS its own budget (create_meta_campaign with dailyBudgetUsd, Advantage+ campaign budget) leave this and lifetimeBudgetUsd OUT: Meta allows a budget at the campaign or the ad set, never both, so the ad set then gets none and shares the campaign’s, and naming one is refused by name before anything is created

description.description: the smaller description line under the headline

destinationType.description: WHERE A CLICK LANDS, and worth deciding for a merchant with a shop. "WEBSITE" sends it to their own site — their pixel fires, their email capture runs, their upsell flow works. "WEBSITE_AND_SHOP" lets Meta route it into the in-app Facebook/Instagram Shop instead: often fewer taps to a purchase, but the visit never reaches their site. FROM META API v26 AN ADVERTISER WITH A SHOP DEFAULTS TO WEBSITE_AND_SHOP, so pass "WEBSITE_AND_SHOP_OPT_OUT" to keep every click on their own site. Also accepts APP, MESSENGER, INSTAGRAM_DIRECT, WHATSAPP, ON_AD, ON_POST, ON_PAGE, ON_EVENT, ON_VIDEO, SHOP_AUTOMATIC. An unknown value is refused by name, and the read-back says in words where clicks will go. CLICK-TO-WHATSAPP ADS (certified against Meta 2026-09-03): pass destinationType "WHATSAPP", cta "WHATSAPP_MESSAGE" and optimizationGoal "CONVERSATIONS" (objective OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT). Meta refuses the ad set unless the Page already has a WhatsApp number linked (Facebook Page settings > WhatsApp) — that link is made on Facebook, not here, and needs no extra Hermoso permission. The shop choice is sent on the ad CREATIVE (destination_spec) — "WEBSITE" or "WEBSITE_AND_SHOP_OPT_OUT" switches the in-app Shop OFF, "WEBSITE_AND_SHOP" switches it on — and the reply reads back what Meta stored.

dsaBeneficiary.description: EU AD TRANSPARENCY: the person or organisation this ad promotes (Meta shows it on the ad). Meta requires it whenever the ad set reaches the EU; omit it and Hermoso uses the ad account's own default, else this profile's brand name, else the Page name, and the summary says which was used

dsaPayor.description: EU AD TRANSPARENCY: who pays for the ads (Meta shows it on the ad). Omit it and it matches dsaBeneficiary

format.description: auto = one ad per asset (image or video); carousel = ONE multi-card ad

imageUrl.description: public https image URL for the ad creative

imageUrls.description: several image URLs -> one ad each, or the carousel cards in order

instagramUserId.description: run it on Instagram under the brand’s own handle

leadFormId.description: LEAD ADS — attach an instant form (from list_meta_lead_forms / create_meta_lead_form) so the button opens that form INSIDE Facebook/Instagram instead of sending the click to a website. Requires objective:"OUTCOME_LEADS"; the ad set is then optimized for LEAD_GENERATION and pointed at the form automatically. Read the submissions afterwards with read_meta_leads.

lifetimeBudgetUsd.description: a fixed total instead of a daily budget, in the ad account's currency — REQUIRES endTime

link.description: destination URL (defaults to the brand domain)

name.description: base name for the campaign/ad set/ads

objectStoreUrl.description: app store link for an app-install ad

optimizationGoal.description: override, e.g. OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS / LANDING_PAGE_VIEWS / THRUPLAY / VALUE

pageId.description: Omit when the brand has one Page; with several the call lists them, so ask the user which one.

partnershipAdCode.description: PARTNERSHIP AD FROM A CREATOR'S CODE: the ad code a creator shares for their own Instagram post (their post > ... > Partnership label and ads > Ad code). The ad promotes THEIR post as a partnership ad run by this brand — no media id needed. Use INSTEAD of boostPostId; cannot be combined with your own media, a catalog or carousel. An expired or unknown code is refused in plain words.

partnershipAdFormat.description: Which identities a boosted partnership post shows (Meta's ad_format): both = creator AND brand (Meta's default), single = only the first identity, auto = Meta picks per impression (Instagram only). Only with partnershipAdCode or boostPostId.

pixelId.description: Meta Pixel id — with this the ad set optimizes for a real CONVERSION instead of falling back to link clicks

playableAssetId.description: a PLAYABLE from upload_meta_playable, shown after the lead-in video. Needs adSetId of an App Installs ad set and exactly ONE video; the button installs the app the ad set promotes

productSetId.description: CATALOG (dynamic product) ADS. Meta binds a catalog at TWO levels and they are different ids on different objects: the CAMPAIGN takes productCatalogId, the AD SET takes productSetId. Passing a CATALOG id here is refused by name rather than moved, because Meta’s own error for a mis-placed id names neither the level nor the right field. Cannot be combined with pixelId — an ad set has exactly one promoted_object — and its conversion event is conversionEvent, which Meta defaults to PURCHASE.

specialAdCategories.description: legally required when the ad falls in one of these categories — it restricts targeting

targeting.description: full Meta ad-set targeting — age, gender, geo, interests, behaviours, audiences, languages, placements, devices. Use EXACTLY these key names: an unrecognised one (e.g. geoLocations) is REFUSED by name — it is never dropped, because a dropped geo key used to fall back to targeting the United States.

advantageAudience.description: let Meta expand beyond your audience (Advantage+ audience)

audienceNetworkPositions.description: Audience Network placement names, as Meta defines them

name.description: interest name, for readability; the id is what targets

customAudiences.description: saved audiences AND lookalikes — a lookalike IS a custom audience id

name.description: interest name, for readability; the id is what targets

deviceExpansion.description: only with devicePlatforms / userOs: true lets Meta also show the ad on OTHER devices and operating systems (its "Reach more people across other mobile devices", Sales campaigns only). Default false keeps delivery to exactly the devices and OS you targeted — Hermoso sends the opt-out explicitly, because Meta turns this on by default for new Sales ad sets from Graph v27

excludedBehaviors.description: behaviors to exclude: list of {id, name}

name.description: interest name, for readability; the id is what targets

excludedCustomAudiences.description: custom audiences to exclude: list of {id, name}

name.description: interest name, for readability; the id is what targets

cities.description: city KEYS; radius works here (10–50 mi / 17–80 km)

distanceUnit.description: mile or kilometer; the unit the radius is measured in

key.description: Meta numeric city key, from find_meta_audiences

radius.description: radius around the city: 10 to 50 miles or 17 to 80 kilometers

distanceUnit.description: mile or kilometer; the unit the radius is measured in

latitude.description: latitude of a custom pin location

longitude.description: longitude of a custom pin location

radius.description: radius around the pin: 0.63 to 50 miles or 1 to 80 kilometers

key.description: Meta geo market (DMA) key (the ads location search returns it)

locationTypes.description: people who LIVE there vs were recently there

key.description: Meta numeric region key (the ads location search returns it)

zips.description: postal codes to target: list of {key}

key.description: Meta postal code key (the ads location search returns it)

excludedInterests.description: interests to exclude: list of {id, name}

name.description: interest name, for readability; the id is what targets

facebookPositions.description: feed, story, facebook_reels, marketplace, search, instream_video, right_hand_column, …

flexibleSpec.description: AND across entries, OR within one

behaviors.description: behaviors in this group, matched as OR within the group: list of {id, name}

interests.description: interests in this group, matched as OR within the group: list of {id, name}

instagramPositions.description: stream, story, reels, profile_feed, profile_reels, ig_search, explore_home. "explore_home" needs "stream" beside it; the old "explore" placement is retired by Meta and refused

name.description: interest name, for readability; the id is what targets

publisherPlatforms.description: placement platforms: facebook, instagram, audience_network, messenger or threads

threadsPositions.description: Threads feed. Threads needs "instagram" in publisherPlatforms too (and "stream" if you list instagramPositions); the ad runs under the Threads profile linked to the Instagram account, found automatically

threadsUserId.description: THREADS: the Threads account id the ad runs under on Threads. Leave it out: when targeting.publisherPlatforms includes threads (or the ad set already has it), Hermoso finds the Threads profile linked to the Page's Instagram account itself. An existing Facebook or Instagram post (boostPostId) can be shown on Threads this way; an existing THREADS post cannot be boosted (Meta does not offer it), and partnership ads cannot run on Threads.

thumbnailUrl.description: custom video thumbnail (otherwise Meta picks a frame)

urlTags.description: UTM click tracking Meta appends to every click (the creative's url_tags). DEFAULT ON: utm_source=meta&utm_medium=paid&utm_campaign={{campaign.name}}&utm_term={{adset.name}}&utm_content={{ad.name}} (Meta fills the {{…}} per click) — skipped automatically when your link already has utm_ parameters. Pass your own query string to use it exactly as written, or false to send none. Not used on lead-form or click-to-message ads. The reply reads back what Meta stored.

videoUrl.description: a video URL -> a real Meta VIDEO ad (uploaded + transcoded + thumbnailed for you)

whatsappPhoneNumber.description: CLICK-TO-WHATSAPP: the WhatsApp Business number the chat opens with, in international format. Sent as the ad set’s promoted whatsapp_phone_number when destinationType is WHATSAPP; Meta still requires that number to be linked to the Page.
